annotations.title: DNS records lookup: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, NS and more

description: Look up DNS records of a domain over DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1): A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA, SRV, PTR, DS, DNSKEY or HTTPS, with each answer's TTL, the response code (NOERROR, NXDOMAIN…) and whether DNSSEC validated. Use to check email (MX, SPF in TXT), verify a domain, or debug a DNS change; for whether the change has spread use dns_propagation. Example: name=example.com. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

name.description: Domain name (or a URL; its host is used)

type.description: Record type: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA, SRV, PTR, DS, DNSKEY, HTTPS (default A)
